description: This file defines the UriComposer class, which implements the IUriComposer interface and provides functionality to compose picture URIs based on catalog settings.

classes.name: UriComposer
classes.description: Implements URI composition logic for constructing resource URLs based on catalog settings.

methods.name: ComposePicUri
